arStrings.szText: She was an Oracle from the first age of our order. A child of Firstborn who offered blood for glimpses of fate.
Pain was her price, and she carried it longer than any who followed.
Blood-borne athanasia cursed her with unnatural longevity and an intimate understanding of her sisters’ fleeting lives. Fading faster than autumn leaves.
She condemned those who belittled their sacrifice. Vindictive and apathetic to all but the order. Then...she disappeared.
